description: This file defines a set of functions and callbacks for JSON serialization and deserialization within a CMake build system. It includes functions for handling JSON objects, arrays, literals, and a main 'json' function that manages context and callback execution.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function that initializes JSON context, executes callbacks, and delegates JSON processing.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to begin a key-value pair in a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to end a key-value pair in a JSON object, adding a comma if needed.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to end an element in a JSON array, adding a comma if needed.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals like null, true, false, or strings/numbers.
